missedOpportunities: Giving 10 mL/kg (31 mL) of O-negative blood or normal saline over 5-10 minutes for a newborn who did not respond to the algorithm
Recognising pallor, impalpable pulses and a poor response to epinephrine as acute blood loss rather than deepening asphyxia
Starting compressions at 3:1 with ventilation for a heart rate under 60 and placing an advanced airway
Placing an umbilical venous catheter and giving epinephrine 0.02 mg/kg (0.062 mg) IV rather than repeating the endotracheal route
Sending a blood gas, a haemoglobin and a glucose to confirm the cause and guide the next transfusion
